name: Gemäldegalerie
description: Berlin’s main museum of European painting from the 13th to 18th centuries, at the Kulturforum: Rembrandt, Vermeer, Caravaggio, Bruegel.

name: Alte Nationalgalerie
description: A temple-like museum on Museum Island with 19th-century painting and sculpture, including Caspar David Friedrich.

name: Neues Museum
description: A museum on Museum Island, rebuilt after war damage, with Egyptian and prehistoric collections. The bust of Nefertiti is here.

name: Pergamon Museum
description: The museum on Museum Island with the Ishtar Gate of Babylon and the Pergamon Altar. It is closed for a long renovation.

name: Lustgarten
description: The lawn in front of the Altes Museum and Berlin Cathedral on Museum Island, once a royal garden and parade ground.

name: Brandenburg Gate
description: The 18th-century city gate at the end of Unter den Linden, cut off just inside East Berlin while the Wall stood.

name: Reichstag
description: The German parliament building, with a glass dome you can climb for free if you book ahead.

name: Alexanderplatz
description: A big open square in former East Berlin, with the TV tower, the World Clock and a busy train station.

name: Potsdamer Platz
description: A busy square cut in two by the Wall and rebuilt in the 1990s with office towers and the Sony Center.

name: Checkpoint Charlie
description: The best-known crossing point between East and West Berlin during the Cold War, with a replica guard hut.

name: Berghain
description: A techno club in a former power station, open from Saturday night into Monday, with a strict door policy.

name: Berlin Wall Memorial
description: The main memorial to the Berlin Wall, along Bernauer Straße, with a preserved stretch of the border strip and a watchtower.

name: Stasi Museum
description: The former headquarters of East Germany’s secret police, with the minister’s offices kept as they were.

name: Victory Column
description: A tall 19th-century column topped by a gilded Victory, in the middle of the Tiergarten, with a viewing platform.

name: Olympic Stadium
description: The stadium built for the 1936 Olympics, now home to Hertha BSC and the German Cup final.

name: SO36
description: A punk and alternative music club in Kreuzberg, open since 1978.

name: DDR Museum
description: A hands-on museum about everyday life in East Germany, beside the Spree opposite Museum Island.
